{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting issues
print(sales_df['revenue'].unique())

# Count rows with commas in revenue
comma_count = sales_df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum()
print(f"Number of entries with commas: {comma_count}")

# Remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue"}
